test_case_name: Accept all cookies and access the Business section

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies
Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
And then check that the Business section page is displayed

test_case_name: Access Privacy Cookie Policy from the Business section

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
Click the 'Più opzioni' link to access the Privacy - Cookie policy
And then check that the Privacy - Cookie policy page is displayed

test_case_name: Open and close the cookie banner in the Business section

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
Click the 'Chiudi' button to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Corporate' external site from the Business section

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
Click the 'Corporate' link in the external navigation
And then check that the 'Corporate' external site is opened

test_case_name: Open the search bar and perform a search in the Business section (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
Click the 'Search' button to open the search bar
Type $name in the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click the button with class 'btn-search' to submit the search
And then check that the search results are displayed

test_case_name: Reset the search field in the Business section (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
Click the 'Search' button to open the search bar
Type $name in the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field
Click the button with class 'btn-reset-search' to reset the search field
And then check that the search field is cleared

test_case_name: Access guest login and authenticate in the Business section (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
Type $email in the 'E-mail' input field
Type $name in the 'Password' input field
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest
And then check that the guest user is authenticated and redirected appropriately

test_case_name: Access guest login and select 'Mantieni L'accesso' in the Business section (desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu
Type $email in the 'E-mail' input field
Type $name in the 'Password' input field
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest
And then check that the guest user is authenticated and the session is persistent
